problem_type: Provider preference diverges between display and persistence
symptom: Bare gpt-image-2 persists the first catalog vendor rather than preferred APIMart
direct_cause: buildModelEntryIndex uses catalog insertion order while dedupeByModelKey uses saved preference
class_root: No common provider ordering at display and model resolution boundaries
affected_population: Same model key published by multiple vendors
Agent or storyboard nodes without explicit vendor
internal_only_reason: Internal saved provider preference and model identity; no external protocol or dependency change.
invariants: An unpinned model resolves to the earliest saved provider preference; an explicit vendor remains authoritative.
generality_proof: Display deduplication and entry ordering both consume the shared provider ranking with stable catalog fallback. All node writes build the same index.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Stable generic ordering by saved vendor preference

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Chooses first provider in shared preference order
Loads saved preference and orders all entries before consumers index bare model keys

recurrence.reason: Any catalog order or additional vendor can change the incorrect winner.
same_class_scan: rg dedupeByModelKey / buildModelEntryIndex / listAvailableModelsForAgent found composer, Agent and storyboard consumers

prevention.invariant: Saved vendor ordering selects the same winner for every bare model key.
prevention.failure_mode: Unknown vendors remain behind ranked vendors; explicit identities retain their own entries.
prevention.strategy: One shared stable ordering consumed by display and persistence.

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove independent rank implementation; preserve output catalog order.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Internal pure ordering; no third party controls the invariant.

migration: No persisted data rewrite; affects new bare-key resolution only.
residual_risks: Explicit vendor identities intentionally remain pinned; preference changes apply only to later bare-model resolution.
